title: G7: Closing environment, ordinal-valued # and conclusion of SN

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Sub-lemma (S6).** (i) Show each $\mathcal V_\tau$ is nonempty with a canonical least element, so a closing environment $\rho_0$ exists. (ii) Define $\#M:=\mu_\sigma([\![M]\!]_{\rho_0})\in\mathrm{Ord}$ and verify it is a genuine ordinal. (iii) Show the strict comparisons of G5+G6 descend to strict ordinal inequalities $\#M>\#N$ whenever $M\to_\beta N$. (iv) Conclude strong normalization from well-foundedness of $\mathrm{Ord}$: an infinite reduction would give an infinite strictly descending ordinal sequence, contradiction.

**Why care.** This step delivers the required map $\#:\Lambda_\to\to\mathrm{Ord}$ and the SN corollary, and must confirm the whole chain is **SN-free** (the construction nowhere used finiteness of reductions).
